entities.name: Francisco Balbi di Correggio
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Francisco Balbi di Correggio, born in Correggio in the province of Reggio Emilia, Italy, was an arquebusier who served with the Spanish contingent during the Great Siege of Malta. Little is known about him other than that he maintained a journal throughout the siege, which he afterwards published.
